capabilities: Run daily tasks in configurable time slots with start/stop time tracking
Create recurring routines and review execution logs and a yearly heatmap
Link tasks to projects and open project board views
Attach comments, reminders, and reusable recipes to tasks
Hand AI tasks to Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor running in an embedded terminal (Pro)
extras: AI task handoff is a paid Pro feature (license activation with device seats) and works on desktop only; the plugin itself sends no task content over the network and handles no API keys. Bilingual Japanese/English UI.
problem: Obsidian's task support is static lists; it has no built-in view for running today's tasks against time slots while recording what actually got done and when.
